# The erase before each job

Milestone 3, 2026-10-23. [All run sets](README.md), [previous: Rebuilt images](2026-10-22-1624-images-on-the-fixed-base.md), [next: Goose 1.56.0 and Argo v4.1.6](2026-10-24-1306-goose-1-56-and-argo-4-1-6.md).

**Tested:** Whether a job starts only after the slot is erased, whether the worker refuses a job it cannot erase for, and a controller restart during a job.

**Changed since the run set before:** The job program erases the slot before each job and refuses the job when that fails ([ADR 0032](../decisions/0032-erase-the-slot-before-each-job-and-refuse-on-failure.md)). The system text asks each answer to end with a `Status:` and an `Excess:` line.

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Model | Qwen3.5-4B, thinking off |
| Agent | Goose 1.55.0 |
| Workflow | Argo v4.1.5, the `investigate` template: dispatch, then the token's revoke |
| Task | The fixture question, 600 seconds and 6 turns |
